cohort: 303 pregnant women attending antenatal care at Jimma public health institutions.
finding: The proportion of women-friendly care was 60.1%, and it was significantly associated with marital status, residence, mode of delivery, and choice of the health care provider.
mod_finding: Women who delivered vaginally were less likely to report receiving women-friendly care (AOR = 0.18, 95%CI: 0.05-0.6).
